svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT ALPHA field guide
svg.desc: Agent Alpha routes selected AUTOBOT references on request; the ten Agenda context settings start unset.
svg.text: Selected AUTOBOT references and optional Agenda
Find one relevant AUTOBOT reference for this task.
Leave Agenda unset unless I select an option.
Agent Alpha routes up to ten bounded references.
Agenda starts unset; no worker or scheduler starts.
